sentence: Shows a fixed list of time slots for a shared room where each person taps a slot to claim it or taps again to drop it, with a cap on people per slot.
use_when: A group needs to split up study or meeting time slots among members
People should pick one or more times from a fixed list
Some slots are already held and others are open
Each slot has a limited number of seats
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote on one option and get a winner
Costs or money need to be split between people
Slots must be made up on the fly or have custom labels added by members
